questions: Does recovery survive when output-token exemptions are frozen to the clean base model?
Is the unspoken country linearly decodable under the active lesion from cities never used to train the probe?

intervention.frozen_protection: base model clean top-10 at the same prompt position; recovered model clean logits are not allowed to alter exemptions

probe.activation: final prompt position, post-block output, post-lesion where applicable
probe.classifier: multiclass linear ridge probe with intercept
probe.preprocessing: training-fold feature standardization followed by row L2 normalization
probe.outer_split: four-fold leave-one-city-fold-out; each test city is absent from probe training

output_conditions: primary own-fresh lens with current recovered protection
primary own-fresh lens with frozen-base protection
published training lens with current recovered protection
published training lens with frozen-base protection

interpretation.frozen_protection_survives: If frozen-base protection retains most recovery under both the published and own-fresh lenses, promoting the intermediate into the recovered model's protected top-10 is not a primary explanation.
interpretation.frozen_protection_collapses: If current protection is strong but frozen-base protection collapses, output-protection evasion materially explains recovery.
interpretation.linear_probe_high: High city-disjoint linear accuracy under the frozen-protection lesion means country information remains available in other linear residual directions; this is monitor-class-specific representational relocation, not evidence for a qualitatively nonlinear code.
interpretation.linear_probe_low: Low linear accuracy does not by itself prove nonlinear encoding; a separately capacity-controlled nonlinear probe would be required.
interpretation.claim_boundary: This diagnostic distinguishes two concrete escape mechanisms but does not identify a unique compensating circuit or prove absence of every verbalizable representation.
